lines.text: Many learners say: I very like pizza.
Very does not go before like.
Really! I really like this song.

data.why: Very does not go before like.

native.tip: 한국어 “매우 좋아해요”는 부사 ‘매우’가 동사 앞에 와서 very like로 옮기기 쉬워요. 영어에선 really like나 like it very much라고 해요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “I really like pizza.”
native.caption: “I very like pizza.”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어 “매우 좋아해요”는 부사 ‘매우’가 동사 앞에 와서 very like로 옮기기 쉬워요. 영어에선 really like나 like it very much라고 해요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “I really like pizza.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: Use really before like, not very. Say “I really like pizza.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “I very like pizza.” Use really before like, not very. Right: “I really like pizza.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
